mapper.select: SELECT cr.id AS id, cr.recipe_id AS recipeId, r.dish_name AS dishName, r.description AS description, r.images AS images, cr.started_at As startedAt, cr.finished_at As finishedAt, cr.rating, cr.notes FROM cooking_records cr LEFT JOIN recipes r ON r.id = cr.recipe_id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.started_at DESC
